types.name: Fenrir::AssetHandle<Fenrir::Image>
types.doc: Names one asset of kind `T` (`Mesh`, `Image`, `Material`, `Shader`, `Model`, `Skeleton`, `Clip`, `BoneMask`, `InstanceList` or `Font`) in the asset store: a slot index plus the generation the slot had when the asset was made (ADR-0021). Plain data that keeps nothing alive, so components hold it and C# receives it as a value. Once the asset is freed the slot's generation moves on and the handle is stale: it no longer resolves, and users skip it. A default-made handle is empty and never resolves.

types.name: Fenrir::Colour
types.doc: A colour as linear red, green, blue and alpha, each a float, usually in [0, 1] (ADR-0025). Debug draw, materials and lights take it, and the renderer packs it for vertices. Colours written as sRGB hex values, as colour pickers and art tools give them, are converted when made (FromSrgb). Default constructed, it is opaque white.

types.name: Fenrir::Sides
types.doc: One value for each side of a rectangle: border widths, nine-slice insets.

types.name: Fenrir::Border
types.doc: A border's width and colour for each side, inside the rectangle it is drawn on.

types.name: Fenrir::CornerRadii
types.doc: A radius for each corner of a rectangle, in UI units; zero is a sharp corner.

types.name: Fenrir::FillRule
types.doc: Which points a path's fill covers: those it winds round at all, or those it winds round an odd number of times.

types.name: Fenrir::GradientSpread
types.doc: What a gradient does past its ends: keeps its end colours, or starts again.

types.name: Fenrir::GradientStop
types.doc: A gradient's colour at one point along it, from 0 at its start to 1 at its end.

types.name: Fenrir::GroupBlend2D
types.doc: How an offscreen group's premultiplied image combines with what is under it.

values.name: Additive
values.doc: Added: RGB `One` / `One`; alpha `Zero` / `One`, so the target's alpha is kept.

types.name: Fenrir::GroupFilter2D
types.doc: The filter an offscreen group's image is drawn through when it is composited.

values.name: Blur
values.doc: A Gaussian blur of `radius` local units.

values.name: DropShadow
values.doc: The image's alpha, blurred by `radius`, tinted `shadowColour` and drawn `offset` away, under it.

values.name: BackdropBlur
values.doc: What is under the group's bounds blurred by `radius` and drawn back there, then the image over it as `None` draws it. The one composite that reads the target it draws into; it draws even when the group is empty.

types.name: Fenrir::GroupFilter
types.doc: What an offscreen group's image is drawn through when it is composited: nothing, a Gaussian blur, a drop shadow of its alpha under it, or a blur of what is under it (Painter::BackdropBlur). Lengths are UI units under the transform the group begins under.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Which filter.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: The blur's, or the shadow's blur, radius.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Where the shadow is drawn from the group.

fields.name: colour
fields.doc: The shadow's colour, straight alpha.

types.name: Fenrir::LineCap
types.doc: How the open ends of a stroke are drawn.

values.name: Round
values.doc: A half disc about the end point.

values.name: Square
values.doc: Flat, half the width past the end point.

types.name: Fenrir::LineJoin
types.doc: How a stroke turns a corner, on its outer side.

values.name: Miter
values.doc: The outer edges extended to meet, or a bevel where they would reach past the miter limit.

values.name: Bevel
values.doc: A straight edge across the corner.

types.name: Fenrir::NineSlice
types.doc: Nine-slice insets: the image's corners keep their size, its edges stretch along one axis and its middle along both. `insets` are in the image's pixels, measured on an image of `imageSize` pixels, and drawn at the same size in UI units, scaled down evenly when the rectangle is smaller than they are.

types.name: Fenrir::Rect2D
types.doc: A rectangle in local 2D coordinates: logical units from the top-left, Y down.

types.name: Fenrir::SamplerFilter
types.doc: How a texture is filtered between its pixels and its mips.

values.name: Nearest
values.doc: The nearest pixel of the nearest mip.

values.name: Bilinear
values.doc: Linear between pixels, from the nearest mip.

values.name: Trilinear
values.doc: Linear between pixels and between mips.

types.name: Fenrir::SamplerWrap
types.doc: What a texture does with coordinates outside [0, 1].

types.name: Fenrir::SamplerDescription
types.doc: How a texture parameter is sampled (ADR-0024): its wrap along each axis, filter and anisotropy. The renderer core shares one sampler between parameters with equal descriptions. Default made, it is the spec's default sampler: repeat, trilinear, anisotropy 8.

fields.name: wrapU
fields.doc: The wrap across the texture's width, the U coordinate (glTF's S).

fields.name: wrapV
fields.doc: The wrap down the texture's height, the V coordinate (glTF's T).

fields.name: anisotropy
fields.doc: The most anisotropic filtering taken, 1 for none. The renderer clamps it to what the device has.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptPainter::ImageDraw
types.doc: An image drawn into a rectangle: the image, its sampler, nine-slice insets when NineSliced, and a tint.

fields.name: nineSliced
fields.doc: Whether NineSlice applies: false stretches the image over the rectangle.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptPainter::PaintKind
types.doc: Which paint a Paint is.

values.name: LinearGradient
values.doc: A gradient along the line from Start to End.

values.name: RadialGradient
values.doc: A gradient from Focal out to the circle of Radius about Centre.

values.name: ImagePattern
values.doc: An image repeated over Rect, tinted by Colour.

types.name: Fenrir::Transform2D
types.doc: A 2D affine transform: where it sends the X axis, the Y axis and the origin. A point `p` goes to `x * p.x + y * p.y + origin`. Default constructed, it is the identity.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptPainter::Paint
types.doc: How a fill is coloured: a solid colour, a linear or radial gradient of up to eight stops, or an image pattern. Colours have straight alpha. Gradient and pattern coordinates are in the paint's own space, which Transform places in the shape's space. A gradient of more than two stops draws with its first and last: a script's painter has no stop texture.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Which paint, and so which fields below it reads.

fields.name: colour
fields.doc: The solid colour, or the image pattern's tint.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: A linear gradient's start (offset 0) and end (offset 1).

fields.name: centre
fields.doc: A radial gradient's circle (offset 1) and focal point (offset 0).

fields.name: spread
fields.doc: What a gradient does past its ends.

fields.name: stopCount
fields.doc: How many of Stops a gradient uses, at most eight.

fields.name: stops
fields.doc: A gradient's stops, sorted by offset.

fields.name: transform
fields.doc: Places the paint's own space in the shape's.

fields.name: image
fields.doc: An image pattern's image.

fields.name: sampler
fields.doc: How an image pattern's image is sampled, and what lies outside Rect.

fields.name: rect
fields.doc: Where one copy of an image pattern's image lies.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptPainter::PainterId
types.doc: A painter over the window overlay (Painter.Overlay), which the engine keeps while the C# system that got it runs: a number, so copying it copies no painter. Every Painter call takes one. When the system returns, what it painted is submitted to the overlay and the painter ends; its id is never handed out again, so a later call on it does nothing. The default names none.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Which painter: zero for none.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptPainter::Path2D
types.doc: A path a script made (Path2D.Create) and the engine keeps until the script destroys it: subpaths of lines and Bezier curves in UI units, built through its calls and drawn by Painter.FillPath, Painter.StrokePath and Painter.BeginMask. Plain data, so copying it does not copy the path. A destroyed path's calls do nothing; the default names none.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Which path: zero for none.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptPainter::StrokeStyle
types.doc: How a path is stroked: its width in UI units (zero is a hairline, one pixel wide), its caps and joins, and up to eight dash lengths, alternating on and off from each subpath's start, DashOffset into the pattern.

fields.name: miterLimit
fields.doc: The longest miter, as a multiple of the width, before a corner is bevelled.

fields.name: dashCount
fields.doc: How many of Dashes the stroke uses; zero is a solid line.

types.name: Fenrir::Shadow
types.doc: A box shadow: the rectangle's shape moved by `offset`, grown by `spread` and blurred by `blur` (the CSS blur radius, twice the Gaussian's standard deviation). An outset shadow is drawn outside the rectangle only, an inset one inside it only.

types.name: Fenrir::TextShadow
types.doc: A text shadow: the text drawn again under itself, moved by `offset` (UI units) and in `colour`.

fields.name: colour
fields.doc: Straight alpha, as every painter colour.
